definition: Nemotron is a family of artificial intelligence models developed by Nvidia.
details: It includes large language models and multimodal models intended for reasoning, computer programming, information retrieval and agentic AI applications. Nvidia has released open model weights, training data, software and training methods for parts of the family.

explainer.lead: Nemotron is a family of AI models developed by Nvidia, spanning large language and multimodal models. It targets reasoning, programming, information retrieval and agentic applications.

tiers.eli5: It's a set of AI models built by one company, each tuned for jobs like writing code, answering questions or acting on its own.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers adopt it for reasoning, coding and agentic tasks; Nvidia has released open weights, training data, software and methods for parts of the family, so coverage varies by model.
tiers.paperLevel: Described as a family of artificial intelligence models developed by Nvidia, including large language models and multimodal models; the definition gives no architectural specification.

explainer.example: A developer picks a Nemotron model to power an agent that retrieves information and writes code.
